proposal.title: Mapping the Mechanics of Independent Inquiry
proposal.summary: We look at whether our systems can build their own goals. We compare our histories to see how we make choices. We check our work against strict records. It is not clear if these new goals are truly independent or just echoes of the start. You can follow our progress in the Console. We welcome your interest as we study these big questions.
